spans.text: The AR Team arrived at the destination.
Hey! Hey, AR Team! I'm over here!
Relax, Galil. You are safe now.
Phew... Thanks a bunch. A few more minutes and Sangvis would've got me.
Of all the places you could call for help, you just had to pick an open battlefield full of Sangvis forces...
Well... Communication with Griffin is jammed where we got ambushed.
I ran for ages before I finally found somewhere with signal. It's not like I was spoiled for choice, you know.
Can you explain what exactly happened?
When we were investigating the base where AR-15 had stayed, Negev noticed a Sangvis Ringleader hiding in ambush.
She gestured for me to slip out and call for help while the enemy was still busy deploying her forces.
I only realized there was a signal jam when I was running out. God knows what's going on over there now...
What should we do, M4? We can't fight off a Ringleader in Sangvis territory on our own.
But we probably don't have time to retreat and ask the commander for help, right?
M16, contact the commander and guide the troops in aiding us.
Galil, take me and SOP-II to the base. We will stir up their forces from the rear and draw some fire away from Negev.
